parsed.note_claim: NATO's Article 5 refers to "an armed attack against one or more [NATO members] in Europe or North America".
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Parties agree that an armed attack against one or more of them in Europe or North America shall be considered an attack against them all
parsed.reason: The page contains the official text of the North Atlantic Treaty, specifically Article 5, which explicitly states the geographic limitation to Europe or North America cited in the note.
